citations.quote: Name: Seraphine. Official role tags: Support, Mage.
Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine.
Active: Seraphine shields herself and nearby allied champions for a short time.
Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.
The charm from Encore, which is an immobilize, can trigger the stun from Beat Drop.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Recognizing her team protection and crowd-control chains helps avoid dangerous group engagements.

row.answer: Seraphine is a support mage with AP-scaling magic damage. She repeats basic spells, protects nearby allies, and chains crowd control through enemies.
row.counterplay: Spread out, sidestep her waves, and avoid lining up behind champions.
